# GitHired

> Canada-first public job intelligence for technology roles — employer ATS data, not recruiter spam.

## What GitHired is

GitHired discovers, enriches, filters, and ranks Canadian technology jobs directly from employer career pages and applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, Workable, Rippling, and others).

Website: https://githired.ca
Source: https://github.com/mikegianfelice/GitHired
REST API: https://api.githired.ca/api/v1/jobs
MCP: https://api.githired.ca/mcp
Developer docs: https://githired.ca/developers
Agent docs: https://githired.ca/agents
OpenAPI: https://githired.ca/openapi.json

## How AI agents should connect

1. Prefer MCP Streamable HTTP at `https://api.githired.ca/mcp` (no API key).
2. Cursor: official one-click install deeplink is published on https://githired.ca/agents
3. Claude / ChatGPT: add a custom remote connector/plugin with the same URL (no third-party one-click).
4. Or use the REST API documented at https://githired.ca/developers

## Data methodology

- Jobs are ingested from public employer ATS boards via scheduled discovery.
- Geographic eligibility is deterministic and Canada-first. Confirmed ineligible roles (for example US-only remote) are excluded from the public API and website shortlist.
- Province-restricted remote/hybrid is labeled as province-scoped — never implied Canada-wide.
- Salaries are employer-advertised annual base pay only (CAD/USD). GitHired never invents or estimates compensation.
- Application links are original employer posting URLs.
- Dataset freshness is exposed via `generated_at` / `last_verified` fields and `/api/v1/health`.

## Public API (no auth)

- `GET /api/v1/jobs` — search/filter Canada-eligible jobs (cursor pagination, limit ≤ 50)
- `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}` — job detail (includes description excerpt)
- `GET /api/v1/companies` — tracked employers with active counts
- `GET /api/v1/stats` — aggregate dataset statistics
- `GET /api/v1/health` — service + dataset freshness (`ok` vs `degraded`)
- `POST /api/v1/match` — deterministic profile matching (no résumé storage)

## MCP tools

Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP) at `https://api.githired.ca/mcp`:

- `search_jobs`
- `get_job`
- `match_profile`
- `get_market_stats`

Read-only. No authentication required for normal use. Rate limited (~120 req/min/IP). Profiles/résumés are not stored.

## Important limitations

- Not a complete Canadian labour-market census — only tracked employer ATS boards.
- Public snapshots are capped for Worker/Pages size; check `/api/v1/health` for live count.
- UNCERTAIN geography is excluded from the public confirmed set (precision over recall).
- Match scores are deterministic relevance, not hiring decisions or LLM judgments.
- Publishing an MCP server does not guarantee automatic discovery by ChatGPT/Claude.
- Do not auto-apply to jobs via GitHired.
